data.name: Cruise San Diego Bay
data.headline: For all ages! • 1 Hour • Scenic San Diego Bay Cruise
data.description:
Set sail on a fun and unforgettable boat tour through the calm waters of San Diego Bay for only $49 per person.

7 Days a Week
Up to 6 Passengers
Semi-Private Cruise

meeting_point.address: Gate 1 @ Safe Harbor Marina,  955 Harbor Island Drive, San Diego 92120

data.what_to_bring:
To make the most of your time on the water, here are some helpful tips and items to bring along:

✅ Essentials

- Valid ID – Required for the person who made the booking.
-Reservation confirmation – Digital or printed copy helps speed up check-in.
- Sunscreen – Even on cloudy days, the bay reflects sunlight strongly.
-Sunglasses & hat – To protect your eyes and face from glare.
- Light jacket or sweater – It can get breezy on the water, especially later in the day.

🍴 Food & Beverages

- Snacks, dinner or a picnic – Small bites, charcuterie, or takeout work great onboard.
- Drinks – Water, soda, or alcoholic beverages are allowed (21+). Bring cups and openers if needed.
- Cooler or tote – Soft-sided coolers fit best on Duffy boats.

📱 Optional Items
- Phone/camera – Capture your cruise moments!
- Playlist – Most boats have built-in systems, but check ahead.
- Blanket – For cozy evening cruises.

🚫 Please Note
- No smoking or vaping.
- No swimming or jumping off the boat.
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.

data.check_in_details:
Please meet your captain at Gate 1 of Sunroad Marina.
This gate is located at the northernmost end of the marina, in the direction away from downtown San Diego.

Your captain will meet you there and personally escort you to your boat.
